messages:
noah: alert from auditor-bot: object in s3://partner-onboard-state contains a `vault_ciphertext` field in plain terraform state. looks like a wrapped blob landed in public partner bucket. marking P0.
sophia: omg. which key was used to wrap it? any idea if it's our transit key or partner kms?
noah: quick inspect: `jq .resources[] .instances[] .attributes | grep vault_ciphertext` returned entries. the ciphertext header includes `transit/keys/platform-key` which is our vault transit path.
devsec: if our transit key was referenced in a public state file that's bad. immediate actions: 1) make S3 object private, 2) rotate transit key, 3) revoke any Vault tokens that could have used transit:encrypt, 4) audit logs for decrypt calls.
auditor-bot: s3 acl change applied -> object now private. (change id s3-acl-332).
infra-bot: incident created INC-2026-0522. linked to alert id: a-77ab.
noah: i'm going to snapshot the state object and move to secure bucket for forensics, then scrub the public copy. command: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://partner-onboard-state/terraform.tfstate /tmp/tfstate-4340123456.json
aws s3 mv s3://partner-onboard-state/terraform.tfstate s3://sec-evidence/INC-2026-0522/tfstate-4340123456.json
```
sophia: good. while you do that i'll check Vault audit logs for any decrypt/rewrap calls against `transit/keys/platform-key`. run: 
```
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log
# then grep
grep "transit/decrypt" /var/log/vault_audit.log | grep platform-key
```
devsec: if we see suspect decrypts, capture caller token accessor and IP. then rotate the transit key and rewrap any ciphertexts referencing old key. note: Vault transit rotation is asymmetric; we should create a new key version and call rewrap.
noah: snapshot done and public copy replaced with a sanitized version (removed `vault_ciphertext` entries). moved original to gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-0522/tfstate.orig.json (kms-wrapped).
auditor-bot: forensic snapshot saved (object id f-991).
infra-bot: temporary RBAC: removed `transit/keys/platform-key` write/rewrap permission from partner onboarding token role. change id rb-443.
sophia: logs show two decrypt attempts in the last 48h from token accessor t-9c8b and source IP 34.120.11.22. unknown service. capturing entries.
devsec: escalate: revoke token accessor t-9c8b immediately. run: `vault token revoke -accessor t-9c8b` and rotate the transit key: `vault write -f transit/keys/platform-key/rotate`. after rotate, run `vault write transit/rewrap platform-key ciphertext=<old>` for stored blobs.
noah: revoked accessor and rotated key. commands executed.
```
vault token revoke -accessor t-9c8b
vault write -f transit/keys/platform-key/rotate
```
noah: we should also create a short-lived detection rule in logging to notify on any future decrypt operations against platform-key. auditor-bot can create a metric.
auditor-bot: log metric created: detect-transit-platform-key-decrypts -> alert on 1 event in 10m.
oncall: notify partner POC (cc:legal). message to partner: we found an onboarding state with a wrapped blob referencing our transit key. we've secured the object, rotated keys, and need them to pull updated wrapped blobs via our Vault endpoint. do not distribute raw keys.
sophia: next: search repos and artifacts for `vault_ciphertext` and `transit/keys/platform-key` references and list hits. noah can you run a quick repo grep + artifact storage scan?
noah: running grep across monorepo and artifact buckets. found three historical CI artifacts that contained the same field (ci-artifact-2025-11-02.tar.gz). scheduling artifact quarantine and rotation.
devsec: rotation plan for consumers: 1) create new ciphertexts with new transit key (use `vault write transit/rewrap`), 2) push updated blobs to secure bucket, 3) update integrations to fetch from vault instead of S3, 4) add a pre-commit hook to block plaintext `vault_ciphertext` or `PRIVATE_KEY` in commits.
sophia: also policy change: restrict Vault transit keys so only infra service accounts can call encrypt/rewrap. add time-limited tokens for partners rather than long-lived ones.
noah: i'm quarantining artifacts and updating Terraform state references to use `data "vault_generic_secret"` instead of embedded ciphertext. will open PR to onboarding docs.
auditor-bot: evidence bundle created and uploaded to gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-0522/bundle.zip. access: secops only.
oncall: legal notified, partner POC looped in, joint call scheduled in 60m. keep all communications minimal: rotated keys, secured object, next steps for them to fetch new blobs.
devsec: post-incident tasks: - rotate any KMS keys that could have been used to wrap evidence during transit - enforce backend-only secret storage (no bucket writeback for state) - add audit log export to readonly SIEM for longer retention.
sophia: one more: create a one-click vault rewrap job in Console to help partners re-encrypt older blobs after key rotation. i'll file a ticket.
noah: thanks. closing immediate loop: public object secured, transit key rotated, token revoked, artifacts quarantined, incident created. will follow up with a short postmortem and detection improvements.
